title: chronicle-writer: compact onboarding abstracts and deterministic release zipper
author: Priya Raman
description: Context: onboarding churn and release-note noise slow cross-team reviews. Large profile uploads include verbose provenance and full sample dumps; downstream consumers only need a small, deterministic artifact to verify compatibility and pull release summaries. This PR introduces the 'chronicle-writer' pipeline which emits a compact, deterministic zip (the 'chronicle') containing: a lightweight onboarding abstract (machine + human friendly), a sampled provenance manifest (configurable seed & reservoir size), delta fingerprints for fast diffs, and a concise release index used by downstream syncers. Motivation: speed up reviews, reduce artifact size for audits, and enable deterministic release replays for regressions. What this PR changes: 1) chronicle service: new CLI and server handler to build deterministic zips from profile uploads; 2) compact-onboard-abstract: a templated, schema-backed one-page summary derived from model metadata + top-k perf tokens; 3) sampled-provenance: reservoir sampler integrated into the onboard pipeline with seed control to ensure reproducible samples; 4) zipper: deterministic packaging/ordering + SHA256 manifest and timestamping; 5) release-sync helpers: small client library to fetch and validate chronicles and apply delta patches. Compatibility notes: chronicles are opt-in at onboarding and enabled by default for curated workflows; they are additive and do not replace existing full-profile bundles. Checklist: - [x] CLI + server handlers implemented - [x] deterministic ordering + manifest hashing - [x] reservoir sampling with seed control - [x] tests for determinism under varying node counts - [x] basic docs and QuickStart snippet - [x] migration script to backfill chronicles for recent 30 days Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag chronicle.enabled=false, enable for curated bucket the next day, observe storage and review latency for 72h, then flip default for new uploads. Related work: ties to ENG-8842 (release UX) and the release zipper RFC (internal link).

ci_summary: CI: unit (pass), integration (pass), lint (pass), e2e-chronicle (pass) - full matrix on python 3.10/3.11; flaky test rerun not required.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash on 2024-10-05 after approvals from Jared, Linnea; deploy gated behind feature flag.
release_notes: Adds 'chronicle' deterministic release artifacts: compact onboarding abstracts, sampled provenance manifests, and deterministic zips for faster review and audit. Opt-in via chronicle.enabled; backfill migration provided.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag chronicle.enabled=false at merge. Migration script registry/migrations/20241003_backfill_chronicles.py is idempotent and rate-limited; schedule backfill during low-traffic window. Monitor storage.delta and review.latency dashboards for first 72h.
qa_instructions: 1) Upload a test profile with chronicle.enabled=true and fixed chronicle_seed=42. 2) Run chronicle CLI to produce zip and validate SHA against expected vector in tests/chronicle/vectors/42.sha256. 3) Run client sync validate to ensure delta apply restores expected minimal state.
human_summary: This PR adds a compact, deterministic packaging flow ('chronicle') that produces small, verifiable release artifacts to accelerate onboarding reviews and reduce storage/transfer costs. It's additive, tested for determinism, and released behind a feature flag with a backfill tool.
